title: Bootstrap 6 Navigation — 8 Free Navbar, Menu & Sidebar Examples
excerpt: Eight free Bootstrap 6 navigation examples — navbar with drawer, menus, nav overflow, tabs, sidebar rail, centered masthead, breadcrumbs and ScrollSpy.
yoastTitle: Bootstrap 6 Navigation — 8 Free Navbar & Menu Examples
yoastDesc: Eight free Bootstrap 6 navigation examples covering navbars, menus, the new Nav overflow, tabs, sidebar rails, breadcrumbs and the rebuilt ScrollSpy. Doubles as a v5 migration reference.
intro: Eight Bootstrap 6 navigation patterns, each on its own page. Navigation changed more between v5 and v6 than any other area of the framework, so this pack doubles as a migration reference — every example calls out what moved and why.
note: The headline changes: .navbar-collapse no longer exists and the mobile menu is a native <dialog class="drawer">; Dropdown became Menu with no wrapper and no toggle class; Nav overflow is entirely new; breadcrumb separators are real elements; and ScrollSpy was rebuilt on IntersectionObserver with offset replaced by top-margin.
summary: Bootstrap 6 Navigation is a pack of eight navigation examples: a standard navbar with drawer mobile menu, dropdown menus built on the new Menu component, the new Nav overflow that folds items into a menu automatically, tabs and pills, an application sidebar rail, a centered editorial masthead, breadcrumbs with pagination, and a working ScrollSpy table of contents. Each page explains what changed from Bootstrap 5. ESM-only, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Eight navigation patterns, each on its own page with prev/next navigation
Standard navbar showing the v6 drawer pattern that replaces .navbar-collapse
Dropdown menus using the new Menu component, positioned by Floating UI
Nav overflow — items fold into a menu automatically, new in v6
Tabs with fade panels, plus the pill variant
Application sidebar rail, with the .navbar-nav column-by-default gotcha explained
Centered editorial masthead using a three-column grid
Breadcrumbs with the new .breadcrumb-link and real divider elements, plus pagination
Working ScrollSpy contents rebuilt on IntersectionObserver, with top-margin
Every example notes what changed from Bootstrap 5 — a migration reference as much as a pack
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
